instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/two_sided_part.step in FreeCAD Path/CAM. Use FreeCAD with the Path/CAM modules. Create A-side and B-side FreeCAD Path/CAM Jobs or independent machining coordinate systems. Use a Side A Pocket operation to machine the open pocket; use a Side B Counterbore operation to machine the four counterbores. Tool definitions: use T1 as an end mill, T2 as a drill, and T3 as a counterbore tool for side A and side B; use S7000 rpm and F500 mm/min for these tools. Write the required output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-17_A.nc, /home/user/Desktop/task-17_B.nc. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH).
